mazda_cx5_technical_guide_manual997.pdf.t: BASIC SYSTEM • The opening angle adjustment is performed according to the balance of the following forces: — Refrigerant pressure (Pd) in diaphragm Refrigerant gas pressure (Pl) of evaporator under diaphragm — Spring force (Fs) pushing up ball valve • If the refrigerant gas temperature from the evaporator increases, the expansion valve increases the amount of refrigerant according to the following operations: 1. The temperature of the temperature sensor tightly sealed against the diaphragm increases. 2. The refrigerant in the diaphragm warms and the Pd increases. 3. If this Pd increases more than Pl + Fs, the diaphragm is pressed down. 4. The Shaft installed to the temperature sensor end presses down the ball valve. 5. The amount of refrigerant is increased.
